//: Preset for tsc-built shared libraries (packages/*). Libraries emit JS plus
declarations into dist/ in a single tsc pass, which is why this preset
intentionally does NOT set emitDeclarationOnly or noEmit.
allowImportingTsExtensions is legal only with noEmit or emitDeclarationOnly.
Because libraries emit JS via tsc, this preset must never enable
allowImportingTsExtensions. A future declaration-only consumer (whose JS
is emitted by a bundler) must set emitDeclarationOnly explicitly.
Path-based options (outDir, rootDir, include) intentionally live in each
package: relative paths inside a shared preset resolve against the preset
Known safe relaxations vs base reflect current package usage:
Per-package deltas (target, lib, types, jsx, verbatimModuleSyntax,
include/exclude) stay in each package tsconfig.json.
